ORDER The petitioner has challenged an order passed by the 3rd respondent/the Designated Officer, Food Safety and Drug Administration, Salem and seeks a quash of the same with several consequential prayers.

entities.text: Food Safety and Drug Administration, Salem
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The petitioner is aggrieved by the sealing of its premises in Salem District and has set out various grievances in regard to the sealing per se, as well as the conduct of the officers in the course of the search.

2.However, Mr.M.R.Gokul Krishnan, learned Additional Government Pleader, who accepts notice for R1 to R3 would point out that the petitioner has made an appeal challenging impugned order dated https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 14.02.2024 and the appeal has been listed before the appellate authority for hearing on 18.03.2024.

The said hearing has been communicated to the petitioner vide notice dated 13.03.2024.
3.In light of the aforesaid
, the petitioner may well pursue the appellate remedy availed by him.
This writ petition is found not maintainable and the same is dismissed with liberty.
No costs.
Connected miscellaneous petitions are closed.
